page.layout: One printed page of running text. In the left margin, beside the first paragraph, the reference "Esaj.60.22.". Beside the second paragraph, a multi-line italic marginal note. Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: Sicut aues volantes pullis suis opitulantur, sic protegęt[?] Dominus Ecclesiam suam, protegendo & liberando, transiliendo & seruando : decipientque pauperes populi fidelis, inimicos suos, & possessores suos tandem possidebunt. Huc respiciant quos dejicit spei (quae innumeris Dei promissionibus stabilienda erat) infirmitas: qui timent ne vel paruum vel caducum multo labore lucrum conquirant. Confidant Esaj.60.22. ei, qui ita suis se affore promisit,ut paruus illorum coetus in gentem validam futurus sit: nam virgultum plantationis ejus quod plantabit inter gentes, erit opus manuum ejus, ut eo nomen suum glorificet: non denegabit sterilis ager incrementum huic plantationi, nec æstu persecutionis enecabitur, quia descendet ros benedictionis a Domino, & irrigabit faciem terræ.

Erunt qui-busdam locis barbariinfi-delium mores tolerandi.Populorum quos adibimus, inculta quibusdam in locis & barbara, plenaque ferocitatis vita, nobis haud magis intra-ctabilis erit, quam olim similis morum ruditas, in Scythis & Sauromatis Christi præcones impedivit, Evangelij cursum inhibuit; in Deo enim nostro, cum Dauide murum transilimus & exercitum conteri-mus.In ipso faciemus militiam,& ipse conculcabit inimicos nostros: conteret dentes eorum

page.notes: Doubtful word: "protegęt[?]" (the printed form is hard to read, probably protegat or protegit). The long s is printed as f throughout and is transcribed as s, so "poffeffores", "poffidebunt", "promifit", "ftabilienda", "fpei" and "aestu" are given with plain s. The marginal note is set in italic; its line breaks follow the print. The line "barbariinfi-" is printed with no space before "infi-". The text reads "protegetDominus" with no space in the print. The text runs over from the previous page.
